newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid issued 10 bln pta five year FRNs.
newsitem.headline: Madrid issued 10 bln pta five year FRNs.

text.p: Spain's Madrid regional government launched on Monday 10 billion pesetas of five-year floating rate notes, maturing on December 20, 2001, lead-manager Bank of America said.
Other lead-managers were Citibank, Societe Generale and JP Morgan. Fees were undisclosed. The nominal value is 100 pesetas.
The note will pay semi-annual coupons on December 20 and June 20. The coupon, which is Libor plus 0.07, will be fixed two working days before and based on the Reuter page FRBG.
Moody's rating of Madrid is A1.
